instruction: Split the book PDF into separate files for each chapter, matching the naming format of the first chapter, and create files for all 8 chapters in sequence.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 8 numbered chapter PDFs (1 through 8). Evaluator checks that all chapter numbers from 1 to 8 are present in the directory. It extracts the leading number from each filename matching 'N. Title.pdf' pattern and verifies the sequence is complete. Partial credit is given based on how many of the required numbers (1-8) are present.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit: each correct chapter number (1-8) contributes 1/8 to the final score

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: checks for 8 numbered chapter files (1-8) in the target directory
Getter logic correctly extracts numbered PDF files using regex pattern '^\d+\. ' matching the 'N. Title.pdf' format
Metric logic correctly verifies complete sequence from 1 to 8, providing appropriate partial credit for incomplete sequences
Expected parameter handling is correct: directly accesses 'start' and 'end' keys since expected.type='rule' means get_rule returns rules dict
Data flow is correct: getter extracts (number, filename) tuples, metric checks if all required numbers 1-8 are present
Partial credit logic is sensible: each chapter contributes 1/8 to final score
Implementation is robust: handles empty directories, missing files, and sorts results correctly
